description: This PHP class 'I18NService' handles internationalization functionalities within the OrangeHRM system. It manages translation message retrieval, caching, ETag generation, and interaction with translation resources for different languages, facilitating localization features.

classes.name: I18NService
classes.description: A service class for managing internationalization (i18n) translation messages, including loading, caching, and providing translation utilities.

methods.name: getI18NDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the I18N data access object.

methods.name: addLanguage
methods.description: Registers a language and its resource type, throws if already added.

methods.name: isLanguageLoaded
methods.description: Checks if a language-resource combination is loaded.

methods.name: generateCacheKeyPrefixForLang
methods.description: Generates a cache key prefix for a given language.

methods.name: generateTranslationCacheKey
methods.description: Generates cache key for translation messages of a specific language.

methods.name: generateTranslationKeyTargetArrayCacheKey
methods.description: Generates cache key for key-target translation array.

methods.name: generateTranslationSourceTargetArrayCacheKey
methods.description: Generates cache key for source-target translation array.

methods.name: generateETagCacheKey
methods.description: Generates cache key for ETag associated with a language.

methods.name: getTranslationCollection
methods.description: Retrieves and constructs a TranslationCollection object for a language.

methods.name: getTranslationMessagesAsJsonStringAlongWithCache
methods.description: Retrieves translation messages and related data as JSON string, utilizing cache.

methods.name: getETagAlongWithCache
methods.description: Generates or retrieves the ETag for a language based on its translation messages.

methods.name: getTranslationMessagesAsJsonString
methods.description: Returns the translation messages as a JSON string, with cache supporting.

methods.name: getTranslationMessagesKeyTargetArray
methods.description: Gets the key-target translation array for a language, with cache.

methods.name: getTranslationMessagesSourceTargetArray
methods.description: Gets source-target translation array for a language, with cache.

methods.name: cleanAndRefetchIfCacheNotHit
methods.description: Refetches cache items if cache miss occurs, and clears related cache keys.

methods.name: getETagByLangCode
methods.description: Retrieves or computes the ETag for the specified language.

methods.name: getTranslator
methods.description: Lazily initializes and retrieves the Symfony Translator instance.

methods.name: setTranslatorLanguage
methods.description: Sets the current translation locale for the Translator.

methods.name: trans
methods.description: Translates a key into the target language, adding resource if not loaded.

methods.name: transBySource
methods.description: Translates a source string into the target language.

methods.name: cleanCacheByLangCode
methods.description: Clears all cache entries for a specific language.
